title: SIDESTORY: IL SIRACUSANO RERUN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: IL SIRACUSANO RERUN
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: IL Siracusano event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions and the Solo Actions, and redeeming from Event Store.
EVENT STAGE DURATION:
[Stagione delle Piogge]
[Pistole e Ordine]
[Terra Desolata Autoproclamata]
[Solo Actions]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete Solo Actions in [Volsinii] to gain rewards.

REWARDS: Vigil's Folder (When first obtained, players will receive the event bonus Operator ★★★★★★: Vigil, after which you can use it to increase his potential), Siracusan Court of Justice Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
[Menù del Banchetto]

DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Menù del Banchetto] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards. MAIN REWARDS: Siracusan Court of Justice Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, Permesso di Importazione, etc.
[Dipartimento di Sicurezza Alimentare]

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain [Permesso di Importazione] by participating in the event. [Permesso di Importazione] can be used to redeem items from [Dipartimento di Sicurezza Alimentare].
REWARDS: Siracusan Court of Justice Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
NOTE:

The requirements to obtain certain medals of this event have been updated. Players who have participated in the original event and met the adjusted requirements will receive the corresponding medals once log in.
Once the rerun ends, the Medal Set of this event can no longer be obtained via any method, including the [Side Story].
This event rerun will carry on the stage progress and First Clear progress.

The once-only rewards in the rerun will automatically be converted to Intelligence Certificates for players who have already claimed them. Please refer to [Intelligence Certificate Conversion Rules] for more details.
Items in the Intelligence Certification Area will have the available purchase amount increased on top of the existing amount and have new items added when event reruns begin.
Operators Texas the Omertosa, Penance, Vigil, and Lunacub will gain more trust during the event rerun.
After the event ends, this event will be included in the [Side Story] permanently from June 6, 2024, 04:00 (UTC-7).
02 EPOQUE COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Outfit will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
EPOQUE Collection - The Other Side of Siracusa for Vigil
03 [WITCH FEAST] SERIES RE-EDITION AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
[Witch Feast] Series - Moon Catastrborn for Blemishine
[Witch Feast] Series - Echo of the Horrorlair for Shamare
[Witch Feast] Series - Fated Hero for Snowsant
04 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET - 'SIRACUSAN RETRO' & SIRACUSAN COURT OF JUSTICE
DETAILS: During the event, the themed furniture 'Siracusan Retro' and Siracusan Court of Justice will be available at store.
'Siracusan Retro'
HOW TO OBTAIN: Limited-time sale at the Store: May 23, 2024, 10:00 - June 6, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Siracusan Court of Justice
HOW TO OBTAIN:
Obtainable as event rewards and available for redemption in the event store.
Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces): May 23, 2024, 10:00 - June 6, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Please stay tuned for more information!
